name: SINES Data Campus
status_note: Six-building campus planned to 1.2 GW by 2030 (Start Campus); SIN01 in operation since Oct 2024 and running Nvidia GB300s for Microsoft via Nscale since Q1 2026; SIN02 under construction (Epoch: 233 MW IT by Q3 2027).

construction_start.note: Epoch satellite: land clearing for SIN01 begins Jan 2022.

operational.note: ECO News (Mar 2025): SIN01 in operation since October 2024.
